folder.title: Folder
folder.description: A notebook or category used to organize notes

name.description: Name of the folder (can be encrypted)

ownerId.description: UID of the user who owns this folder

isEncrypted.description: Whether the folder details are encrypted client-side

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the folder was created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the folder was last updated

note.title: Note
note.description: A markdown note which can be encrypted and assigned to a folder

title.description: Title of the note (can be encrypted)

content.description: Markdown text content of the note (can be encrypted)

folderId.description: ID of the folder this note belongs to, empty if none

ownerId.description: UID of the user who owns this note

isEncrypted.description: Whether the title and content are encrypted client-side

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the note was created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the note was last updated
